children: Philippine inflation this year is likely to undershoot the central bank's projections, Barclays economist Brian Tan says in a note. Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas forecast full-year inflation at 6.1% during its August meeting, implying that price increases would average between 7.5% and 7.6% for August to December. Headline CPI rose 6.1% in August. After the August print came in above expectations, Barclays raises its 2026 inflation forecast to 5.6% from 5.4%, also taking into account elevated global oil prices. (amanda.lee@wsj.com)
